We met each other when we didn't need each other, but I think God wanted us to be together. ❤️

I know we're not perfect, but I'll try to be perfect for each other. I don't need many people in my life — I just want you with me forever. ♾️

I want you to understand me. Sometimes when I'm not in a good mood, I say things in anger that I don't mean. Sometimes I overthink, because I feel like you'll leave me someday. 🙃

When we fight, you act like you don't want me in your life — like you don't care if I go. 🙃🥀 But I care a lot. I don't always show it, but I've cried a lot. 🙃🙃

I keep asking you to change for me, but I think I can't change you — only you can change yourself, and I know you won't. 🙃

Stay forever with me. ❤️❤️

Our talking stage

It started with a random "hey" and a "who's this?" — and somehow it never really stopped after that. Our talking stage was full of ignored Snaps, missed calls, and me getting worked up over the smallest things.

But it was also full of goodnight texts, reminders to eat and take your medicine, and you making sure I'd reached home safe. Between all the teasing and the little dramas, something quietly changed. 🤍

Two strangers became…
